export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const access = bid ? await getBackendRealmAccess(bid) : emptyRealmAccess;
  const soulNavigation = [{ label: '我的主页', command: '/我' }];
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const pageMatch = e.MessageText.match(/(\d+)/);

  if (!pageMatch) {
    const content = Format.createMarkdown();

    content.addText('从主页开始，点击按钮即可操作，不用记住所有指令。');
    content.addNewline();
    content.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('成长路线：主线 → 修为 → 突破／晋级 → 继续挑战。'));
    content.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('每日先签到，再打开任务面板查看当前可做、可领取的事项。'));
    content.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('装备、社交、宗门、活动与设置，在「更多」中按分类查找。'));
    content.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('成长指引分三个阶段：/帮助 1、/帮助 2、/帮助 3。'));
    const visible = new Set([...access.moreVisibleCommands, ...access.foldVisibleCommands]);
    const shortcuts = [
      { label: '主线', command: '/查看主线' },
      { label: '秘境', command: '/查看秘境' },
      { label: '境界', command: '/我的境界' },
      { label: '功法', command: '/我的功法' }
    ].filter(item => visible.has(item.command));

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '修仙帮助',
        content,
        header: access.registered
          ? [
              { label: '签到', command: '/签到' },
              { label: '任务面板', command: '/任务面板' }
            ]
          : [],
        footer: access.registered
          ? [
              shortcuts,
              [
                { label: '成长指引', command: '/帮助 1' },
                { label: '更多玩法', command: '/更多' },
                { label: '主页', command: '/我' }
              ]
            ]
          : [
              [
                { label: '踏入仙途', command: '/踏入仙途' },
                { label: '成长指引', command: '/帮助 1' }
              ]
            ]
      })
    );

    return;
  }
  let page = pageMatch ? parseInt(pageMatch[1]) : 1;

  if (page < 1) {
    page = 1;
  }
  if (page > 3) {
    page = 3;
  }

  const newcomerGuide = NEWCOMER_STAGE_GUIDES[page as keyof typeof NEWCOMER_STAGE_GUIDES];

  if (newcomerGuide) {
    {
      const content = Format.createMarkdown();

      content.addText(newcomerGuide.subtitle);
      content.addNewline();
      content.addNewline();

      for (const section of newcomerGuide.sections) {
        content.addBold(section.title);
        content.addNewline();

        for (const line of section.lines) {
          content.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${line}`));
        }

        content.addNewline();
      }

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: newcomerGuide.title,
          content,
          footer: [...newcomerGuide.footer, ...soulNavigation]
        })
      );
    }
  }
});
